scientific_integrity: All rank and torsion conclusions use exhaustive exact integral unit cancellation with zero residual differential. Finite-field checks are independent corroboration; not evidence of torsion-freeness by themselves.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite integral classification for 2 <= n <= 6; no claim for n >= 7, no general homotopy type or explicit full group actions.
title: Integral homology and the first mixed-degree threshold for long-cycle permutation complexes
